title: OpeningsFromLayer Command
description: Cut door or window openings from wall solids using plan-layer geometry. Ignores door swing blocks when gap polylines exist. Creates selectable opening_marker boxes on A-OPEN stamped with forsk:sill, forsk:head, forsk:width. Door/window blocks are not created. Layer X-EXIST returns count 0: existing underlay is not a bake source.

layer.description: Source layer name (door or window, case-insensitive).

sill.description: Opening bottom Z. Default 0 for door, 900 for window.

target_layer.description: Layer holding wall solids to cut. Default A-WALL.

wall_ids.description: Optional wall solid GUIDs. If omitted, all solids on target_layer are used.

limit.description: Optional cap on openings processed (hero-only / stability mode).

pad.description: XY pad added to the opening width so the cutter clears the wall. Default 50.

min_depth.description: Minimum cutter depth through the wall (wall thickness + pad). Default 250.
